## OfferUtils.resolveReceiverIfMakerIsSeller() function

Resolves and validates the maker-seller receiver field for an offer side.

Use this before `Offer.create` when side-specific receiver defaults must be displayed to a maker. `Offer.create` calls it internally.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function resolveReceiverIfMakerIsSeller(params: {
        readonly buy: boolean;
        readonly maker: Address;
        readonly receiverIfMakerIsSeller?: Address;
    }): `0x${string}`;
```

**Returns:**

\`0x${string}\`

Receiver address to put on the offer.

## Exceptions

`InvalidOfferParameterError` when a buy offer sets a non-zero maker-seller receiver.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.buy`<!-- -->: Whether the maker buys loan assets.

- `params.maker`<!-- -->: Maker address used as the default sell-side receiver.

- `params.receiverIfMakerIsSeller`<!-- -->: Optional receiver used when maker is seller.

## Example


```ts
import { OfferUtils } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

const receiver = OfferUtils.resolveReceiverIfMakerIsSeller({
  buy: true,
  maker: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001",
});
console.log(receiver);
```
